title: Hospital medicine directorate
goal: Show clinical, nursing, and allied-health reporting in one directorate.

rubric.must: Dr Helen Ward is visibly at the chief-of-medicine root.
Acute Medicine and Cardiology consultants visibly lead their named registrars.
The director of nursing visibly leads ward and cath-lab nursing leads.
The allied-health lead visibly leads physiotherapy and pharmacy.
The clinical-coordination relationship is visibly dashed and labelled.
